reason: The hypothesis makes several specific mechanistic claims about entropy-driven uniformity, enhanced diffusion, and selective oxidation, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the claimed entropy-diffusion coupling or the direct link between high entropy and selective oxidation kinetics in HEAs.
premises: High mixing entropy promotes uniform elemental distribution
Uniform distribution enables selective oxidation of a key element (Al or Cr)
The key element diffuses faster to the surface due to high entropy
Selective oxidation forms a continuous, adherent, protective oxide layer
Reducing the key element content degrades oxide protectiveness
